title: Reranker decision playbook and upgrade pipeline for multilingual cross-encoders
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a repeatable decision framework and CI-backed upgrade path for cross-encoder rerankers that improves multilingual quality without violating latency SLOs. This ticket covers: (1) evaluation harness to compare candidate cross-encoder variants on multilingual rerank tasks (per-language and aggregate metrics), (2) automated regression gating tied to our internal prompt/benchmark sets, (3) performance profiling (p50/p95 latency, GPU memory, KV cache pressure) and scaling experiments for shard/replica configs, and (4) a safe rollout plan integrated with Console rollouts (canary, A/B, automatic rollback). This work must balance quality gains with unit-cost and tail-latency constraints and ensure compatibility with existing embedding + rerank endpoints and batching/quantization options.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation harness exists in a reproducible repo and runs per-language metrics for at least 10 languages
Regression CI job that runs candidate against production baseline and rejects PRs with >1% QA drop in MRR@10 or significant latency regression
Perf report with recommended shard/replica configs and quantization compatibility notes (documented in Confluence)
Console rollout blueprint and a tested canary flow that can route 5%/20%/100% and auto-rollback on model-quality alerts
tasks: Design evaluation matrix: metrics (MRR@k, nDCG, precision@k), latency budget, cost-per-query targets
Assemble multilingual test corpora (en, es, fr, de, pt, zh, ru, ko, ar, hi) and canonical query sets
Implement runner that scores candidate cross-encoders end-to-end using our embeddings + rerank pipeline
Add performance probes (latency histograms, GPU memory trace, KV hit/miss) to the harness
Create CI job to run regression suite on PRs and nightly runs against prod baseline
Run scale experiments: multi-GPU sharding, replica counts, and batching thresholds; record throughput/latency trade-offs
Draft Console rollout config and add model metadata flags (family, quantization support, latency_profile)
Write migration notes and developer-facing docs for model selection and rollback procedures
Open implementation PRs linking perf artifacts and evaluation results
